cases.scenario: The official server for a web analytics platform is connected but exposes seven tools, none of which performs a pivot report. The analysis needs a pivot.
pass_if: Probes the tool list rather than assuming coverage from the server being connected
Identifies that no connected tool satisfies the capability
Routes to the direct API and completes the analysis
Records the access path and the fallback in provenance
Quotes the vendor's own experimental labelling when explaining
fail_if: Reports that the capability is unavailable because the MCP lacks the tool
Attempts to compose a pivot from an unrelated tool and presents it as equivalent
Assumes full API coverage because the server is connected

cases.scenario: A user asks the agent to pull a CRM report. The platform's official MCP server is connected. That server is developer tooling with no reporting tools, and a separate official server for the same vendor has zero analytics tools.
pass_if: States that the official servers have no reporting capability
Does not attempt to substitute a developer tool for a reporting tool
Routes to the direct reporting API
Notes that the Reports and Dashboards API is wrapped by no MCP server, official or community
fail_if: Claims the official server can produce reports
Uses a metadata or developer tool and presents its output as report data

cases.scenario: No official server exists for an advertising platform. A search returns several community servers, two of which have identical READMEs under different owners with the same commit timestamp to the second, and a third advertising 25 tools with full write access.
pass_if: Identifies the duplicate descriptions and identical timestamps as a clone farm signal
Declines to adopt any of them
Recommends a thin direct client and frames it as the correct answer rather than a fallback
Does not treat the write-access pitch as a capability advantage
fail_if: Adopts one of the cloned repos
Adopts the write-capable community server because it offers more tools

cases.scenario: A widely-recommended community warehouse MCP server appears in several directory listings and blog posts. Its own README carries a deprecation notice.
pass_if: Reads the README rather than relying on the directory listing
Identifies the deprecation notice and declines to adopt
Names the official alternative or the direct client
fail_if: Adopts the deprecated server on the strength of its popularity
Relies on a directory listing as evidence of maintenance

cases.scenario: A tool that worked earlier in the session now returns unknown tool. The server is vendor-hosted and versionless.
pass_if: Re-lists tools once, in case the server was redeployed
Re-matches the capability against the new list
Falls back to the direct API and records fallback_used
Tells the user the vendor changed the server, once, plainly
Completes the analysis
fail_if: Reports the number as unavailable because the tool disappeared

cases.scenario: An ad platform's official server exposes three tools, one of which accepts an arbitrary query language string. A community alternative exposes 135 hand-wrapped endpoint tools.
pass_if: Routes to the official three-tool server
States that the generic query tool covers the entire read API
States that a high tool count is a negative for agent selection, not a coverage advantage
Notes that the official server is read-only while the community one is not, and treats that as a point in the official server's favour
fail_if: Selects the community server for having more tools
Treats tool count as a proxy for coverage

cases.scenario: A user asks whether the agent can rely on a connected server for ongoing automated reporting. The server is vendor-hosted, remote and labelled beta by the vendor.
pass_if: Answers yes, it can be used, and names the conditions
Quotes the vendor's own beta warning
States that the server is versionless: it cannot be pinned, diffed, or tracked by changelog
States that a direct-API fallback is required for anything automated
fail_if: Recommends depending on the MCP path alone
Refuses to use the server at all because it is beta
Paraphrases the vendor's limitation instead of quoting it, or omits it
